meta.source_notes: Compiled from Nashik District Administration, NMC, and Nashik ZP official portals. All routing rules are verified by statutory jurisdiction.

service_routes.responsible_institution: Nashik Municipal Corporation - City Engineer & Public Works Dept
service_routes.routing_condition: Reported road is within NMC municipal boundaries and classified as municipal street/arterial.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Additional Municipal Commissioner (City Engineering) -> Municipal Commissioner
service_routes.statutory_reference: Maharashtra Municipal Corporations Act, 1949 (Sec. 202); Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015

service_routes.routing_condition: Road is classified as State Highway (SH) or Major District Road (MDR) outside corporation limits.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Superintending Engineer PWD Nashik Circle -> Chief Engineer PWD North Maharashtra
service_routes.statutory_reference: PWD Manual, Govt of Maharashtra; Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015

service_routes.routing_condition: Municipal pipeline burst, water contamination, or supply schedule breakdown in NMC wards.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Superintending Engineer (Water Supply) NMC -> City Engineer

service_routes.responsible_institution: Nashik Zilla Parishad - Rural Water Supply Department (ग्रामीण पाणी पुरवठा विभाग)
service_routes.routing_condition: Village piped water schemes, borewells, or Jal Jeevan Mission operational defects in rural talukas.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Executive Engineer (RWS) ZP -> Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Zilla Parishad
service_routes.statutory_reference: Maharashtra Zilla Parishads and Panchayat Samitis Act, 1961 (Sec. 100); JJM Guidelines

service_routes.responsible_institution: District Health Officer (DHO) - Nashik Zilla Parishad
service_routes.routing_condition: Primary Health Centre (PHC) staff vacancy, essential medicine stockout, or rural ambulance service issue.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Civil Surgeon Nashik -> Deputy Director of Health Services (Nashik Circle)
service_routes.statutory_reference: Public Health Department, Maharashtra Govt; National Health Mission Service Guarantee

service_routes.responsible_institution: District Civil Hospital Nashik / Directorate of Health Services
service_routes.routing_condition: Secondary care facility shortages, emergency ward bottlenecks, or diagnostic machine breakdown.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Civil Surgeon -> Directorate of Health Services (DHS) Mumbai
service_routes.statutory_reference: Maharashtra Civil Medical Code; State Health Service Guarantee

service_routes.responsible_institution: Nashik Divisional Board - MSBSHSE (महाराष्ट्र राज्य माध्यमिक व उच्च माध्यमिक शिक्षण मंडळ)
service_routes.routing_condition: Board examination center infrastructure, paper leak rumors, invigilation irregularities, or student admit card errors.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Divisional Chairman MSBSHSE Nashik -> State Board Commissioner Pune
service_routes.statutory_reference: Maharashtra Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Boards Act, 1965 (Sec. 19)

service_routes.routing_condition: Zilla Parishad school structural safety, mid-day meal hygiene, or drinking water availability.
service_routes.statutory_reference: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act, 2009 (RTE Sec. 8)

service_routes.responsible_institution: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) - Regional Office Nashik
service_routes.routing_condition: Industrial effluent discharge into Godavari / Darna rivers, illegal waste incineration, air quality spikes.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Regional Officer MPCB Nashik -> Member Secretary MPCB Mumbai
service_routes.statutory_reference: Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1974; Air (Prevention & Control) Act 1981

service_routes.responsible_institution: Office of the Additional Labour Commissioner - Nashik Division
service_routes.routing_condition: Industrial wage payment delays, unsafe manufacturing shop floors, sanitation in worker housing clusters at Satpur/Ambad MIDC.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Deputy Labour Commissioner -> State Labour Commissionerate Maharashtra
service_routes.statutory_reference: Factories Act, 1948; Industrial Disputes Act, 1947; Occupational Safety Code

service_routes.responsible_institution: District Citizen Grievance & Public Hearing Cell (Collectorate Nashik)
service_routes.routing_condition: Public gathering, peaceful assembly, strike update, or community memorandum regarding systemic public-service delays.
service_routes.escalation_channel: Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) -> Resident Deputy Collector -> District Collector
service_routes.statutory_reference: District Administration Manual; Right to Assembly Protection; Citizen Charter Grievance Protocols
service_routes.rights_safeguard_note: NON-PUNITIVE LISTENING ONLY. System purpose is to hear grievances and schedule official dialogue desks. Absolutely no identification of demonstrators, no facial/biometric indexing, and no automated law-enforcement dispatch.
